rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 3 h from approved workshops/seminars or scientific recordings/electronic programs by the Board or AAVSB RACE; up to 2 h may be 1 h consultation with another RVT or veterinarian plus 1 h professional journal reading
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the reporting period in which the technician graduates and is first licensed in Missouri.
rules.carryover: Hours may be reported the following year, but never more than one renewal year after being earned.
rules.audit_note: Board audits; keep records for the current and two previous reporting periods.
rules.notes: Registered veterinary technicians certify 5 CE hours per year; reporting period Dec 1 - Nov 30.
